tagline: Create algorithm videos for TikTok / Reels / Shorts
title: Title
subtitle: Subtitle
exportNote: Real-time render via MediaRecorder; takes ~ video length.
videoIncludes: Video exports include chart and code panel.
audioInVideo: Audio is embedded into the exported video.
settingsResetConfirmDescription: This clears local overrides stored in this browser. The app will use configured defaults again, and generated files will not be deleted.
settingsVoiceDescription: Piper paths, voice mapping, and default voice settings.
settingsPiperExeDescription: Path to piper.exe, for example models/.venv/Scripts/piper.exe.
settingsDefaultVoiceDescription: Default voice, for example M1/F1 or an imported custom voice.
settingsDataDescription: Configure where app-generated data and the background music library are stored.
settingsServerDataDirDescription: Root folder for files generated by the app, including audio, previews, videos, and rendered background music.
settingsMusicLibraryDirDescription: Folder containing the background music library. Each track should be in its own folder, with License.txt when YouTube credit is needed.
settingsSelectMusicLibraryFolder: Select the background music library folder
settingsApiKeyDescription: API keys and connection settings for local/cloud voice providers.
settingsElevenLabsApiKeyDescription: API key for ElevenLabs PRO. The value is stored locally in the browser and sent to the backend through runtime headers.
settingsSupertonicBaseUrlDescription: URL of the local Supertonic server, default http://127.0.0.1:6688.
settingsSupertonicModelDescription: Supertonic model to use, for example supertonic-3.
settingsRvcApplioBaseUrlDescription: URL of the local Applio/RVC Gradio server, for example http://127.0.0.1:6969.
settingsRvcApplioApiNameDescription: Endpoint copied from the Gradio /config dependencies, for example /enforce_terms.
settingsRvcApplioArgTemplateDescription: JSON array of Gradio arguments. Use placeholders like ${input}, ${model}, ${index}, ${pitch}, ${f0_method}.
settingsRvcApplioVoiceDescription: RVC/Applio converts the Piper source voice into your trained custom voice model.
settingsHealthDescription: Check the local backend, piper.exe, voice services, and available models.
settingsElevenLabsVoicesDescription: Declare the voices that appear in the ElevenLabs dropdown.
settingsNoVoices: No voices yet. Click Add voice to enter a Voice ID.
settingsOverridesCleared: Local runtime overrides cleared. The app will use .env/default values.
